text: Reminder to check tins for dents before they go on the shelves pls
on it 👍 we got a load of the cheap stuff in today 😅
What do we do with dented ones
Bin the ones with bulges or sharp dents, small dents on the side are fine. If unsure put it aside and ask whoever's on
Ok
i found like 6 with bulges 🫣 is that ok to chuck or do they go in the other box
Chuck them, not the other box. Nice spot tho
ty 🙌
just got in from placement 😩 dead on my feet. did anyone check the tinned tomatoes
nvm found them, one dented, binned it 🥫❌
is anyone on monday 7th or is it just sarah and terry. i can prob do 4 onwards after school 🙏
Me and Terry, Ellie said maybe. Stock check is the 4pm one anyway, come if you can 🙂
ok 👍 ill try
Got a van of stuff for the Knowle lot this afternoon. Can drop the spare pallets at the church Thurs if anyone's around?
Thurs I'm in till 2 then off. Ellie's on placement thurs right?
yeah on till 6 thurs 😭 but i'm finished at the vets by 6 tonight so i could do tonight?? 🐶
Tonight's fine. Pallets are in the back of the van, needs two people to get them off 😅
Bit heavy for one
I'll come if nobody else can
Terry you are not lifting pallets 😂 Ellie and Sam is fine
I can hold the door
just finished school 😩 paper round in 20 then i can come tonight if ellie doesnt mind
oh yes come!! extra pair of hands 🙌 should be done by 8ish
🙌 ty
Leaving now, be there about 7:45. Ellie you still walking or getting the bus?
home!! feet are dead 😩🥳 pallets all in, sam you're a beast
Home. Back out at 6 for the Hartcliffe drop so going to bed now
home. mum made me eat tea standing up
going to bed. first time ive been up this late on a school night in weeks
Pallets sorted?
Yeah all in the back store, ellie got the top ones
Great
Up. Heading out to Hartcliffe now
Bit mad at the counter this morning. Anyone know if the Knowle lot still want the Sat sort or has that changed
Sat is on as far as I know. Mrs Okafor rang me, she wants the blue folder back by Monday
If anyone's got it
mocks back today maths is gonna be bad
Good luck!! 🤞
Hartcliffe done. Knowle want one more van Sat if anyone's spare for the afternoon
I'm on tomorrow 😭 but i can do the late one sat if nobody else can 🐾
finally off placement a dog ate a whole sock today. dog is fine. sock was not
Poor dog 😂
home. maths 4 🙃😭 everything else was fine ish
4 is a pass mate
Good lad
Sat afternoon, can someone take the Knowle drop if Ellie's on the sort 🙏
I'll do it, Hartcliffe's Mon not Sat
anyone up? cant sleep 😩
